# Requirements: multiply, divide, power

## R1: Multiply
As a calc user, I want to multiply, so that I can scale values.
- R1.1 WHEN multiply(a, b) is called with two numbers THE SYSTEM SHALL return a times b

## R2: Divide
As a calc user, I want to divide, so that I can compute ratios.
- R2.1 WHEN divide(a, b) is called with b not 0 THE SYSTEM SHALL return a divided by b
- R2.2 IF divide(a, b) is called with b equal to 0 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL throw a RangeError

## R3: Power
As a calc user, I want powers, so that I can compute squares and cubes.
- R3.1 WHEN power(a, b) is called with two numbers THE SYSTEM SHALL return a to the power b

# Design

Three files like add.js; divide throws RangeError on 0. The three are independent, so their tasks can be built in parallel.

# Tasks

- [ ] T1: Add multiply()
  - Requirements: R1.1
  - Paths: multiply.js, test/multiply.test.js
  - Depends on: none
- [ ] T2: Add divide()
  - Requirements: R2.1, R2.2
  - Paths: divide.js, test/divide.test.js
  - Depends on: none
- [ ] T3: Add power()
  - Requirements: R3.1
  - Paths: power.js, test/power.test.js
  - Depends on: none
export const multiply = (a, b) => a * b;
export const power = (a, b) => a ** b;
